tldr: Sun in the 1st house: identity becomes personal through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
body:
With the Sun in the 1st house, this part of you develops through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life. The Sun describes identity, vitality, confidence, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center. In practice, this brings attention to how you enter the room, respond first, take up space, and let the world meet you.

When this placement is supported, you can meet life with more self-trust and less need to explain yourself first. The Sun can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose.

When it is strained, you may become overly focused on how you are seen, or push your body past what it is trying to tell you. The harder pattern can show up as over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
challenge: over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth around identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
